description: The deploy job runs on any successful ci run, and ci also runs on pull_request, so a pull request's code (head_sha) is deployed to production with the deploy identity; the job must check github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' and the branch.

The deploy workflow has no concurrency group, so two ci runs finishing close together start two production deploys at once and the older commit can land last, rolling production back; add a concurrency group for the production deploy (cancel-in-progress: false).
